subject: Make persistent state locality explicit for named Powers touched by convergence

body.text: Do not run another whole-repo inventory. Instead, as current CLI/finance work touches a named Power, require every persistent store it uses to declare one of four roles against the mature owner graph: CANONICAL_OWNER, LOCAL_OCCURRENCE/SCRATCH, MATERIALIZED_CACHE/PROJECTION, or HISTORICAL_COMPATIBILITY. A named Power may retain its public identity while its old sqlite/filesystem state becomes a compatibility projection; that store must not silently outrank WorkGraph, EvidenceGraph, Time, Authority, FinancialMetabolism, ProviderGraph, or other canonical owners. Carry validity/locality and source refs for migrated rows. If a cache/projection is stale, rederive rather than treating it as truth. If a local occurrence store is needed for BonfyreReason/Time/Meter, make its promotion/evidence boundary explicit. Expose the mapping through existing shell/WHY/owner introspection where possible. This state-locality contract lets agents communicate about 'where truth lives' with a small typed fact instead of re-litigating ownership in prose.
